items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: But you don't remember who owned Wasco or?

ctx.x: Like I said, if I knew that these were the questions you were going to ask, I'd have brought my briefcase. It would have been more simple to ask because I have all the listings of the questions that you're asking, but it's hard to remember right off hand, you know, without looking in a book. Mm-hmm. But you don't remember who owned Wasco or?

Wasco, no. I really don't. No. So all through this period, when you were recording, you obviously weren't making that much money off your records, so how were you supporting yourself? Through your gigs or playing? Doing your gambling? Doing your gambling.
Doing your gambling, you know. That was your real, your sole support?
